title: Make the login and lock screens look the same
line: The login screen's keyboard layout and on-screen keyboard buttons now look and work like the lock screen's.
explanation: Of the differences listed in the bug, the virtual keyboard button and avatar size had already been aligned, but the SDDM Breeze theme's keyboard layout button was still a text-only "Keyboard Layout: English" button opening a menu, while the lock screen (and Plasma Login Manager) show a keyboard icon with the layout name and switch to the next layout on click. The on-screen keyboard button also used older text and icons ("Virtual Keyboard", -on/-off). The change makes the SDDM layout button an icon button with the current layout name that cycles layouts on click, and gives the on-screen keyboard button the lock screen's Show/Hide text and icons.

commits.message:
sddm-theme: make the footer buttons match the lock screen

The keyboard layout button on the login screen was a text-only button
that opened a menu, while the lock screen cycles layouts with an icon
button; it now looks and works the same, as does the on-screen keyboard.

BUG: 417824

patches.diff:
From 0d3303ce7b4c4f0e77c0a05aa9a9cad8027c3349 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:07:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] sddm-theme: make the footer buttons match the lock screen

The keyboard layout button on the login screen was a text-only button
that opened a menu, while the lock screen cycles layouts with an icon
button; it now looks and works the same, as does the on-screen keyboard.

BUG: 417824
---
 sddm-theme/KeyboardButton.qml | 48 +++++------------------------------
 sddm-theme/Main.qml           |  7 +++--
 2 files changed, 12 insertions(+), 43 deletions(-)

diff --git a/sddm-theme/KeyboardButton.qml b/sddm-theme/KeyboardButton.qml
index 5125ef9f8f..9c3cef523b 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/KeyboardButton.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/KeyboardButton.qml
@@ -8,54 +8,20 @@
 import QtQuick
 
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents
-import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 PlasmaComponents.ToolButton {
     id: root
 
-    property int currentIndex: keyboard.currentLayout
-    onCurrentIndexChanged: keyboard.currentLayout = currentIndex
-
-    text: i18ndc("plasma-desktop-sddm-theme", "@action:button opens layout chooser %1 is current", "Keyboard Layout: %1", keyboard.layouts[currentIndex]?.longName ?? "")
+    focusPolicy: Qt.TabFocus
+    Accessible.description: i18ndc("plasma-desktop-sddm-theme", "Button to change keyboard layout", "Switch layout")
+    icon.name: "input-keyboard"
+    text: keyboard.layouts[keyboard.currentLayout]?.longName ?? ""
     visible: keyboard.layouts.length > 1
 
-    checkable: true
-    checked: menu.opened
-    onToggled: {
-        if (checked) {
-            menu.popup(root, 0, 0)
-        } else {
-            menu.dismiss()
-        }
+    onClicked: {
+        keyboard.currentLayout = (keyboard.currentLayout + 1) % keyboard.layouts.length
+        root.keyboardLayoutChanged()
     }
 
     signal keyboardLayoutChanged()
-
-    PlasmaComponents.Menu {
-        id: menu
-        Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
-        Kirigami.Theme.inherit: false
-
-        onAboutToShow: {
-            if (instantiator.model === null) {
-                let layouts = keyboard.layouts;
-                layouts.sort((a, b) => a.longName.localeCompare(b.longName));
-                instantiator.model = layouts;
-            }
-        }
-
-        Instantiator {
-            id: instantiator
-            model: null
-            onObjectAdded: (index, object) => menu.insertItem(index, object)
-            onObjectRemoved: (index, object) => menu.removeItem(object)
-            delegate: PlasmaComponents.MenuItem {
-                text: modelData.longName
-                onTriggered: {
-                    keyboard.currentLayout = keyboard.layouts.indexOf(modelData)
-                    root.keyboardLayoutChanged()
-                }
-            }
-        }
-    }
 }
diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..7c3143f93f 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -447,8 +447,11 @@ Item {
             PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
                 id: virtualKeyboardButton
 
-                text: i18ndc("plasma-desktop-sddm-theme", "Button to show/hide virtual keyboard", "Virtual Keyboard")
-                icon.name: inputPanel.keyboardVisible ? "input-keyboard-virtual-on" : "input-keyboard-virtual-off"
+                focusPolicy: Qt.TabFocus
+                text: inputPanel.keyboardVisible
+                    ? i18ndc("plasma-desktop-sddm-theme", "@action:button", "Hide On-Screen Keyboard")
+                    : i18ndc("plasma-desktop-sddm-theme", "@action:button", "Show On-Screen Keyboard")
+                icon.name: inputPanel.keyboardVisible ? "input-keyboard-virtual-hide" : "input-keyboard-virtual-show"
                 onClicked: inputPanel.toggle()
                 visible: inputPanel.available
 
--
